notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Dying is now optional
notes.content:
Oculto was conceived as an experimental narrative game. The affliction mechanics add tension to the exploration. Thus, Oculto is halfway between a narrative walking simulator and a survival platformer. 

We understand that there are players who prefer one genre or the other, so we have added optional death, for those who prefer more of a horror walking simulator.

In the initial menu settings there is the option to disable death at any time. 

Let me know if you find any bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Radiation Burn
notes.content:
Thanks to watching several gameplays, we've adjusted some gameplay mechanics to make the overall experience more satisfying. These are the changes, among others:

- New Affliction: Radiation Burn.
- Adjustments of other afflictions.
- Number of remaining documents indicator always active.
- Bug fixes in gamepads.
- Bug fixes in explosions.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Void Mine is now Oculto
notes.content:
Hello! We've decided to change the name of the game to Oculto (Hidden). We were never totally satisfied with "Void Mine", we thought it now has a more suitable name for the mysterious tone of the game.

We also took the opportunity to tweak the gameplay and make the game more accessible.

I hope you like the changes. In a few days, the name will change in your library. Please contact us via the forum if you have any difficulties. Thank you very much for your support.

P.S. Take care of yourselves 😷

notes.title: Color Improvement - Build 373
notes.content:
- We've added more visual variety to the levels by applying different [b]color[/b] shades. 
- We've also changed the mechanics of [b]paranoia[/b]. Now it just makes it hard to see, but not to move.

Thanks for the feedback.

notes.title: Config Update
notes.content:
Hi. We've made some small updates:

· Possibility of removing the grain in the configuration.
· Possibility of activating vsync at 60 fps in the configuration.
· Indicator of important achievements in the menu. They appear when the last level is finished.

Thank you.
